summary: Validated deployment-remediation scope end-to-end on preview URL and local startup probe without calling media-generation endpoints. Confirmed standard frontend start command, APP_URL-safe backend import, runtime config portability, supervisor runtime health, and readonly/provider-neutral integrity suites.

minor.issue: Readonly tests prioritize REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL over APP_BASE_URL, which caused false failures when frontend/.env points to production emergent.host; rerun passed after unsetting REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

action_items: Optional hardening: update readonly pytest fixtures to prefer APP_BASE_URL over REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for preview-environment regressions.
Commit currently expected deployment files if pending (frontend/.env, backend/.env, deployment test updates) in the main branch workflow.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/package.json start script is correct and production-safe: node ../src/server.js (no --watch, no --env-file).
src/server.js runtime config remains portable: /config.js resolved to preview origin while frontend/.env targets emergent.host.
Backend APP_URL handling is import-safe (no KeyError): APP_URL defaults to empty string and artifact URL falls back to relative /artifacts/... when absent.
Provider-neutral contract guard remains locked and unchanged (real_ai_video_generation / acs-video-adapter-v1); Node+Python hybrid architecture remains intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not run generation endpoints. If readonly suites are run in preview context, avoid sourcing frontend/.env into REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL or explicitly set APP_BASE_URL precedence. Supervisor currently RUNNING with frontend command '/bin/sh -c node ../src/server.js'.
rca of the issue: Initial readonly suite failures (Deployment not found 400) were environment-target mismatch, not runtime logic defects. Cause: tests resolve BASE_URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL first; frontend/.env now intentionally points to production emergent.host. In preview test runs, this routed requests to non-matching deployment target. Mitigation: run suites with APP_BASE_URL preview URL and unset/override REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, or refactor fixture precedence.
